findings: The finite classifier promotes a supplied sufficient rule upward to supersets of premises and a supplied countermodel downward to subsets it satisfies. It rejects simultaneous positive and negative matches, retains inclusion-minimal alternatives among supplied rules, and leaves other cells UNKNOWN. This is catalog reasoning, not theorem discovery or global weakest-premise inference.

The three fixed vocabularies enumerate 8 unit, 8 ordered and 32 cancellation cells. Four offline tests pass, covering unknowns, deletion controls, alternative rules, catalog inconsistency and the target-interface table. Every row retains authority NONE.

RequirementChecks is generated as #check declarations. Python compares its exact text with the catalog dictionary. Even a successful Lean build would establish declaration existence/type checking, not correspondence of each Python premise string to the theorem type; that semantic dictionary remains a review obligation.

UnitInterpreter soundness structure: each generator vanishes, hence each cofactor term and their sum vanish; derivation_sound gives that sum equals one; nontriviality contradicts one equals zero. The zero-algebra example satisfies the same Laws and equations when nontriviality is removed. These are bounded Expr statements, not rational-polynomial parsing proofs.

TargetDischarge derives no-zero-divisors by a left inverse, associativity and zero multiplication; nontriviality is supplied separately. Its explicit F2 instance uses decidable finite laws. Q/R/C names in the Python table are conditional interface targets, not constructed canonical Lean field instances.

ordered_target_O packages a supplied Ordering as Nonempty Ordering; it does not construct an ordering or independently show it exists for a named target. Target-discharge UNKNOWN entries must remain distinct from mathematical impossibility.

Catalog extension APIs trust supplied rule/countermodel dictionaries and proof-name strings. Their unknown-premise check concerns available premises, not a verified schema for all catalog metadata. Keep these APIs diagnostic or add typed admission before any future authority use.
